scientific_conclusions: The G4 lower-boundary event/reversal defect generalizes across B02, B05, B06, B11, B12 and B16 under the frozen short-horizon dynamic panel.
G4 remains substantially cheaper than the tested R256 Reference implementation on the same runner, with material-dependent cost ratios.
S4 transfers with small-to-moderate continuous profile/storage errors, but it does not reach the R128-vs-R256 numerical comparator in any of the six materials.
SURF_P extrema timing is not interpretable as a candidate-only defect in B02, B11, B12 and B16 because the Reference ladder itself differs by 512 observation steps.
B05 is the only P2A SURF_P material with a candidate-specific 512-step extrema-timing defect against a comparator with zero timing error.
